name: Should I choose marble or slate for high-traffic interior floors?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose marble or slate for high-traffic interior floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between marble and slate comes down to aesthetic preference versus daily maintenance tolerance. Marble delivers an elegant, luminous look that elevates bathroom and kitchen spaces, but it is a softer calcium-based stone susceptible to scratching and acid etching from citrus, vinegar, or harsh cleaners. Slate provides a textured, slip-resistant surface that is naturally durable, stain-resistant, and forgiving of everyday wear, making it popular for entryways and heavy-traffic floors. However, slate tiles can vary dramatically in thickness, requiring careful bedding in mortar, and cleft slate can occasionally flake along natural layer lines over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slate is harder, slip-resistant, and more durable for heavy traffic, whereas marble offers an upscale aesthetic but requires careful protection against scratches and etching.
